name: Elegant Dance — 37-Step Choreography
priority: Continuity, weight control, and connection between gaze and body

sequence.name: Confident Entrance
sequence.instruction: Walk slowly toward the center for 4 counts. Keep shoulders relaxed, eyes forward, and place one foot ahead of the other to mark the rhythm.

sequence.name: Opening Pose
sequence.instruction: For 4 counts, place one hand on the waist while the other softly traces the arm or hair. Maintain eye contact with the audience.

sequence.name: Body Roll
sequence.instruction: Roll the body from chest to hips. Repeat twice in time with the beat.

sequence.name: Hip Sway
sequence.instruction: Sway hips left to right while keeping the torso relatively stable.

sequence.name: Hair Flip or Head Roll
sequence.instruction: Make a slow, controlled head roll or hair movement, avoiding abrupt motion.

sequence.name: Half Turn
sequence.instruction: Slowly turn 180 degrees. Look over the shoulder before completing the turn.

sequence.name: Shoulder Rolls
sequence.instruction: Roll shoulders backward, alternating right and left.

sequence.name: Cross Step
sequence.instruction: Cross one leg in front of the other, adding a small hip movement.

sequence.name: Glide
sequence.instruction: Take two soft side steps, accompanying them with fluid arm movements.

sequence.name: Elegant Squat
sequence.instruction: Slowly bend the knees and lower with a straight back, then rise under control.

sequence.name: Figure Eight
sequence.instruction: Trace a continuous, slow figure-eight pattern with the hips.

sequence.name: Wrapping Arms
sequence.instruction: Raise both arms and spiral them downward around the body without touching intimate areas.

sequence.name: Full Turn
sequence.instruction: Complete a 360-degree turn and finish in a different pose from the opening.

sequence.name: Accented Side Walk
sequence.instruction: Take three soft lateral steps with a light hip accent on the final step.

sequence.name: Chest Isolation
sequence.instruction: Move the chest slightly forward and backward while keeping the hips stable.

sequence.name: Backward Step with Opening
sequence.instruction: Step backward on one leg and open the other slightly. Spread both arms to the sides at shoulder height.

sequence.name: Slow Hip Circle
sequence.instruction: Complete a full hip circle in one direction over 4 counts; keep torso upright.

sequence.name: Diagonal Travel
sequence.instruction: Walk two diagonal steps while facing forward; accompany with one arm following the body line.

sequence.name: Knee Dip and Recovery
sequence.instruction: Bend one knee to lower the weight, recover fluidly, and alternate legs.

sequence.name: Arm Wave
sequence.instruction: Make a continuous wave from shoulder to fingertips along one arm, then switch arms.

sequence.name: Backward Cross Step
sequence.instruction: Cross one leg behind the other, transfer weight, and add a small hip sway.

sequence.name: Torso Twist
sequence.instruction: Rotate torso side to side while keeping hips relatively still; gaze follows the turn.

sequence.name: Slide and Pause
sequence.instruction: Slide one foot sideways, hold a one-count micro-pause, then continue.

sequence.name: Double Hip Sway
sequence.instruction: Perform two slower, broader hip sways, emphasizing the second.

sequence.name: Reverse Half Turn
sequence.instruction: Turn 180 degrees opposite to step 6, ending with a glance over the opposite shoulder.

sequence.name: Arm Raise and Spiral Descent
sequence.instruction: Raise both arms overhead in a controlled manner and lower them in a spiral around the body.

sequence.name: Extended Final Walk
sequence.instruction: Take four or five slow steps along a gently curved line, alternating gaze frontward and sideways.

sequence.name: Combined Figure Eight and Body Roll
sequence.instruction: Combine a hip figure eight with a gentle body roll starting at the chest.

sequence.name: Final Pose Preparation
sequence.instruction: Step slightly forward, place one hand on the waist and prepare the final position with the other.

sequence.name: Final Pose Hold
sequence.instruction: Place one leg ahead, one hand on the waist and the other arm extended or behind the head. Hold the pose for two measures before finishing.

sequence.name: Hands to Hair
sequence.instruction: Lift hands toward the head near ears and temples, fingers touching or adjusting hair; elbows out. Look directly at the camera, mouth slightly open, with a small shoulder sway.

sequence.name: Arms Forward, Thumbs Down
sequence.instruction: Extend both arms straight forward at chest height, fists closed, thumbs pointing down or outward in a thumbs-down/pointing-down gesture. Lean slightly forward and gaze intensely at the camera.

sequence.name: Hands on Head
sequence.instruction: Place palms atop the head, fingers pointing backward and elbows open; add a small chest and shoulder roll while maintaining the position.

sequence.name: Hands Descend to Chest
sequence.instruction: Keep hands on the head one more second, then lower slowly toward the chest. Briefly drop the gaze before looking back up.

sequence.name: Small Rhythmic Hand Gestures
sequence.instruction: At chest height, make small rhythmic finger motions as though marking beats or counting. Move shoulders and torso fluidly.

sequence.name: Hand Heart
sequence.instruction: Bring hands together at the chest as if clapping or crossing wrists, then open them into a heart with thumbs and index fingers in front of face or chest.

sequence.name: Final Overhead Extension
sequence.instruction: From the heart, lift both arms completely overhead, nearly touching hands; finish with arms high, torso slightly arched, and gaze at the camera.
